statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-39979 (GHSA-2hhh-px8h-355p, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-2hhh-px8h-355p): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier, the error path of jv_parse_sized() in libjq formats a caller-supplied counted buffer with %s, so malformed JSON in a buffer that is not NUL-terminated is read past its end, which can disclose memory or crash the process. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/2f09060afab23fe9390cce7cb860b10416e1bf5f, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Checked every jq package in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository for x86_64 and aarch64: 1.8.1-r0 is upstream jq 1.8.1 with Alpine's 3.23 patches, 1.8.1_git20260429-r1 is the same plus upstream commit e47e56d (the CVE-2026-32316 fix), and 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 and 1.8.2_git20261021-r2 are upstream jq 1.8.2. libjq in the jq package and libjq.a in jq-dev of the two 1.8.1 builds lack the length-bounded "(while parsing '%.*s')" error format the fix introduces and still carry the old "(while parsing '%s')" format, and both 1.8.2 builds carry it. The range ends at 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-39979 (GHSA-2hhh-px8h-355p, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-2hhh-px8h-355p): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier, the error path of jv_parse_sized() in libjq formats a caller-supplied counted buffer with %s, so malformed JSON in a buffer that is not NUL-terminated is read past its end, which can disclose memory or crash the process. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/2f09060afab23fe9390cce7cb860b10416e1bf5f, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Debian backported the fix to trixie in 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-39979). Checked every jq build in the DHI Debian 13 repository for amd64 and arm64, using the changelog each package ships and its libjq1 library: rebuilds of Debian 1.7.1-6+deb13u1 and 1.7.1-6+deb13u2, a 1.8.1-5 build (arm64 only) whose changelog is an unreleased Debian 1.8.1-5 snapshot that does not list this CVE, and a rebuild of Debian 1.8.2-1, which is upstream jq 1.8.2. The changelogs of the 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 rebuilds and of 1.8.2-1 list CVE-2026-39979; libjq1 in the rebuild of 1.7.1-6+deb13u1 and in the 1.8.1-5 build lacks the length-bounded "(while parsing '%.*s')" error format the fix introduces, and libjq1 in the rebuilds of 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 and 1.8.2-1 carries it. The range therefore closes at the first 1.7.1-6+deb13u2 rebuild, reopens at 1.8.1-5 and closes again at the rebuild of 1.8.2-1.
